links.outcome: AI silent-mode outputs compared with actual double-reader decisions before clinical use
links.effect: 9,547 cases; 1,135 positive discordant reviewed, 1 additional recall (no cancer); 8 cancers (8.79%) recalled by humans missed by AI; no additional cancers detected by AI.
links.quote: Having missed a significant number of cancers makes it unreliable and not safe to be used in clinical practice.

links.outcome: AI performance on local screening population versus human readers
links.effect: Eight cancers (8.79% of total cancers detected) recalled by human readers were not detected by AI; no additional cancers detected by AI.
links.quote: Performance of AI was inferior to human readers in our unit.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of deploying a commercial mammography AI system as a silent third reader in a live NHS clinical workflow to assess safety and feasibility.
